published.citation: Valenti & Fischer (2005), ApJS 159, 141, as listed by Willamo et al. (2022), Table 2: 5837 K; the source gives no uncertainty, so the range is the value itself, https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.06729

temperature.note: No archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 1835 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: HR 88 is not in the catalogue; kiehling: HR 88 is not among its 60 stars; kharitonov: HR 88 is not in the catalogue; burnashev: BS 88 is not in part2), so the colour is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
